# Copilot instructions

Follow [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for repository-wide engineering and product constraints. Consult `.kiro/specs/astig/` and the relevant `docs/` contract before implementation.

Keep changes within the ASTIG hackathon MVP. AI extracts evidence; deterministic scoring prioritizes; authorized people approve work orders. Prefer validated shared contracts, idempotent asynchronous processing, PostGIS migrations/indexes, focused tests, and explicit failures. Do not add secrets or real imagery.
